open_points.subject: load_config
open_points.text: load_config: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError when the port of the settings is outside 1 to 65535 or when the time zone database does not know their timezone, then MUST call the imported load_connections once with the connections_file of the settings as a Path, letting its DelivererError end the start, and MUST return DeliveryContext with binary_root, state_dir and connections_file of the settings as Path values and their timezone unchanged; it MUST NOT read the credential file.
open_points.other_text: from portal_deliverer.data_provider import BIND_HOST, EXIT_STATUSES, STOP_SIGNALS, TOKEN_ALPHABET, TOKEN_ENCODING, TOKEN_MIN_LENGTH, TOKEN_TRIM_CHARACTERS
open_points.question: Must the literal port bounds be replaced by an imported policy constant added to IMPORTS, or must the requirement stop specifying those values?

open_points.rule:
Inline-данные: таблицы соответствий, allow-lists, пороги, TTL, пути, рейтинги, размеры, словари alias'ов. Значение размещается процедурой 15.2 и доходит до кода одним из трёх путей §15.3.1; note называет
  перечисление адресом `= models.SomeStatus` (член — его именем рядом с адресом, §15.3.1),
  константу — именем импортируемого символа
  (`the imported RETRY_LIMIT constant`), настройку — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The note must replace the inline threshold `1 to 65535` with the name of an imported constant that supplies the port-range policy.
